description: Write purposeful, accurate, and maintainable code comments and API documentation across major programming languages. Use when deciding whether to add or remove comments, writing public API documentation (docstrings, rustdoc, Javadoc, JSDoc, GoDoc), explaining non-obvious algorithms, documenting security invariants, or refactoring noisy, redundant comments. Do not use for README or architecture documents, commit messages (use conventional-commits), changelogs, or when asked to leave comments untouched in a mechanical refactor.
